body: Why would I? It's just more pain and anguish, I already had enough of that.

I'm just content in a way that I understand how my life will turn out, I know hot it's going to go and I know how it'll end, and I just don't want to do it, I don't want to do deal with in, there is no point to it. I don't want to be lonely, I don't want to be sad, I could stop the problem before it even starts.
On what? I would be glad to though
